original_target.title: Can bound entanglement produce a device-independent secret key?

scope_comparison: The local conjecture quantifies all bound-entangled states and all device-independent key protocols. The older no-key theorem treats a particular protocol, and OpenAI272 constructs one dimension-ten PPT no-key state in its stated protocol class. An existential no-key state does not establish universal prohibition or a positive-key counterexample.
